title: How to manage AI investments in the agentic era
summary: Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.
body: Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.
summaryZh: 该文章探讨了企业在智能体时代（Agentic Era）如何科学管理人工智能投资，核心建议包括通过衡量每美元带来的有用工作量、提升运行效率以及规模化部署高价值工作流来优化AI回报。原始信息显示：Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How to manage AI investments in the agentic era”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了关于企业如何在智能体时代管理AI投资、度量投入产出并扩展高价值工作流的指南。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
